findings.description: Filter admission uses startup.prefix as raw READY witness, but startup receive overwrites prefix on every accepted RX. Early READY before INIT DMA completion followed by valid credit-only then TX completion reaches RUNNING with prefix credit-only, causing fault101. This is rejection of a valid startup, not false READY success. Producer notified; keep original frozen sources unchanged.
